ACEPLACE_DESCRIPTION:
AcePlace – Social marketplace. Stack: React/Next.js, TypeScript, Redux, SCSS.

  • FSD Migration: refactored 100+ components (cart, news feed, comments, checkout, etc.), updated 50+ hooks / types, and removed 30k lines of legacy code.
  • Development: created 30+ pages (business account, orders, notifications), 80+ components, and added +57k lines of new code.
  • Optimization: transitioned to new APIs (Next.js Server Actions).

GostAssistent.ru – Technical Standards & Legal Documentation Platform. Stack: React/Next.js, TypeScript, Zustand, SCSS.

  • Refactoring: adapted the frontend to a new auth-flow. Rewrote 100+ API routes, centralizing authentication logic and request handling.
  • Architecture: redesigned the system to initiate data requests on the client side while maintaining secure execution on the server.
  • Development: implemented smart search using MiniSearch, featuring custom stemming, server-side index building, and multiple search modes.
  • Admin Panels: developed internal applications for LLM testing and access token management.
FREELANCE_DESCRIPTION: I have created several projects on React, Vue, and TS/JS. Some of them can be found in Portfolio
IP_DESCRIPTION: I ran an online store, which I had created from scratch using Joomla CMS and later rebuilt with openCart CMS.
OSKO_DESCRIPTION: Working in sales of fountain and heating equipment of German companies, I climbed the career ladder from sales manager to commercial director.
RSS_DESCRIPTION_NODE: I completed the Node.js 2025 Q2 course in 22nd place out of 1,062 students. A RESTful API was created using the NestJS framework. The project includes authentication, logging, and database interaction via TypeORM. It is deployed in Docker. Applications using GraphQL and WebSocket were also written.
RSS_DESCRIPTION_REACT: I finished the React 2023 Q4 course in 24th place out of 1,080 students. Several projects were completed during the course, including a team project for creating an online GraphQL query editor.
RSS_DESCRIPTION_JS: I completed the JAVASCRIPT/FRONT-END 2023Q1 course in the top 50 out of more than 5 thousand students. As part of the training, a number of projects were completed, including the final team project to create an e-commerce application based on the commerce tools service.
MPEI_DESCRIPTION: Faculty of Electrical Equipment and Automation of Industry and Transport, Specialty: electric drive and automation of industrial technological systems.
PROFILE_DESCRIPTION: I work on React and pure JS/TS, I can make responsive layouts and write tests. I am actively studying and constantly expanding my stack. Having come to the frontend from the field of online commerce, I brought from my previous job people skills and an understanding of the client's view of web design. I speak English and German. I live in Moscow, but ready for relocation.
PROJECT_DESCRIPTION_FOL: An online store of equipment for ponds and fountains is built using the OpenCart CMS and a ready-made template. The product range includes more than 2000 goods.
PROJECT_DESCRIPTION_GRAPHIQL: The online editor of GraphQL queries made on React. The functionality includes authorization, a bilingual interface, the ability to select an arbitrary GraphQL API, download its interactive documentation, send requests and display server responses.
PROJECT_DESCRIPTION_SHELTER: The adaptive two-page website of the animal shelter is made in JavaScript and SCSS. It contains a slider and pagination with random on-the-fly generation of content. The task also included pixel perfect implementation of the provided design.
PROJECT_DESCRIPTION_SKATESHOP: The e-commerce application, based on React and the commercetools cloud backend, created by a team of 3 developers I was in.
PROJECT_DESCRIPTION_KEYBOARD: Virtual keyboard on JavaScript with language switching and physical keyboard support.
PROJECT_DESCRIPTION_CSSSELECTORS: A clone of CSS Diner, an online game for training CSS selectors, is made using TypeScript.
PROJECT_DESCRIPTION_MINESWEEPER: Classic Minesweeper game in vanilla JavaScript.
PROJECT_DESCRIPTION_ASYNCRACE: Learning project on client-server interaction. For the game to work, it's necessary to run a node server from which the cars receive information about speed or malfunction.
PROJECT_DESCRIPTION_THISSITE: My personal website on React. The i18next internalization library was used. Routing, color theme switching, and CSS animation were implemented.
PROJECT_DESCRIPTION_VUESNEAKERS: A prototype of a Vue-based online store. Basic functionality is implemented: search, sorting, ordering, favorites. Tailwind CSS was used for styling.
PROJECT_DESCRIPTION_INTERACTIVETABLE: An interactive, editable table built with Vue with draggable and resizable columns and rows. The layout of the table was provided by the client and implemented in pixel perfect mode.
PROJECT_DESCRIPTION_POOLGAME: A pool browser game made with HTML Canvas, React, and TypeScript. You can push the balls and change their color.
PROJECT_DESCRIPTION_TIMER: A pixel perfect layout of a page with a timer and a popup. The layout in Figma was provided by the client.
PROJECT_DESCRIPTION_TASKTRACKER: A full-stack task tracker app built with React and Appwrite cloud backend. Features include user authentication, drag-and-drop functionality, and full CRUD operations for short-term tasks.
PROJECT_DESCRIPTION_TOKENADMIN: A React prototype for access token management featuring authentication and full CRUD functionality (create, read, update, delete). Styled with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components. Data fetching, forms, and routing are powered by TanStack libraries, with state management handled via Zustand.
